描述_EN: although some were made in northern china, green-glazed wares remained a speciality of the south; this dish was produced at the longquan kilns of zhejiang province. later european collectors gave these wares the fanciful name of ‘celadon’. resembling jade, they were admired for their tranquil beauty. green-glazed vessels were exported in large quantities to south-east asia and the middle east. they were often used in buddhist tea ceremonies and meditation rituals. china produced many types of green-glazed wares, in shades ranging from olive to grass to grey-blue.
描述_ZN: although some were made in northern china, green-glazed wares remained a speciality of the south; this dish was produced at the longquan kilns of zhejiang province. 后来的欧洲收藏家给这些器物起了一个奇怪的名字 "青瓷"。 类似于玉石，它们因其静谧的美感而受到推崇。 绿釉器皿被大量出口到东南亚和中东地区。 它们经常被用于佛教的茶道和冥想仪式中。 中国生产了许多类型的绿釉器皿，色调从橄榄到草到灰蓝不等。
